description: SvTabs with closable tabs and tab positions in Svelte 5. Tabs close browser-style from an x button or the Delete key on the focused tab, an add button opens a new one and onClose lets the parent update the tabs array; tabPosition places the strip at top, bottom, left or right, with left and right rendering vertical tabs.

faq.question: How do I make a tab closable?
faq.answer: Set closable on its entry and handle onClose, which receives the id; remove it from the array and, if it was active, move value to a neighbour as the demo does.

faq.question: What happens when the strip overflows?
faq.answer: The strip scrolls horizontally with scroll buttons at the ends, so many open tabs stay reachable without wrapping.

faq.question: Which keys work?
faq.answer: Arrow keys move between tabs, Home and End jump to the ends, and Delete closes the focused tab when it is closable.
